subject: Transition: Emberly Diagnostics — Ramp plan & CS owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Emberly Diagnostics — post-signing handoff + SOW

Hi Olga,

Congrats — Emberly signed last night. High level: 12-month committed Dedicated cluster, expected go-live mid-May, primary use cases are clinical-note summarization (low-latency) and embeddings for search. ACV $420k; payment terms standard net-30. Procurement will route SOW via DocuSign (I attached SOW_Emberly_v1.2.pdf).

Key operational expectations from customer:
- Dedicated capacity with predictable p99 latency <= 450ms for 1.5k qps bursts
- Data retention and audit logs for 12 months; KMS key requested
- Weekly sync during ramp, then biweekly steady-state check-ins

Open items for CS/Implementation:
1) Confirm primary CS/Implementation owner and backup.
2) Validate network topology for on-prem connector (Carlos is network lead).
3) Draft kickoff agenda and initial milestone dates (can we target May 16 go-live?).

Attachments: SOW_Emberly_v1.2.pdf, emberly_network_diagram.png, onboarding_checklist_MAY.xlsx

Please assign an owner and call out any red flags. I can join the kickoff but want CS to lead day-to-day.

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole | Senior AE, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0168

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Emberly Diagnostics — post-signing handoff + SOW

Thanks Marissa — great summary and congrats to the deal team.

I will take primary ownership of the account contact for the first 2 weeks to run intake and scope. Ben, can you be implementation lead for the Dedicated cluster provisioning and networking? Ben — specific asks below:

- Confirm whether we can meet the requested p99 <= 450ms at the expected model profile (we should validate against the model they selected).
- Review emberly_network_diagram.png and flag any firewall/VPC peering gaps.
- I will run the kickoff and own the mutual action plan; please prepare an initial runbook for provisioning and a resource estimate (hours) for the first 30 days.

Marissa — please introduce Carlos and Leah on the next thread (if they're not already in the DocuSign flow) so we can align procurement/channeling.

Tentative kickoff window: May 9–11 for technical pre-checks, May 16 target for go-live. If procurement delays, we push by 1–2 weeks.

Olga
Olga Petrov | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 206-555-0122

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Emberly Diagnostics — post-signing handoff + SOW

Olga / Marissa — I reviewed their network diagram and SOW. Quick notes:

- The requested model is a 13B family with some 1-token-to-1-token prompt patterns. On our Dedicated config I'd expect baseline p99 ~380–420ms provided we enable KV cache and batching config they recommended. We should include a short perf-validation plan before kickoff.
- The diagram shows a single NAT egress; we'll need a static IP for allowlisting. Suggest a small pre-provisioned NAT or Azure/AWS Elastic IP based on their cloud.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) — procurement will need the KMS ARN and a short KMS integration checklist.

I'll draft a provisioning estimate: ~24 engineer-hours for initial provisioning + 16 hours for validation & perf testing over two weeks. Will attach the runbook snapshot by EOD.

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 510-555-0199

(Attachment: provisioning_runbook_snapshot.txt)

From: Leah Martinez <leah.martinez@emberlydx.com>

Date: 2027-04-04T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transition: Emberly Diagnostics — Ramp plan & CS owners

Hi Olga — thanks for the quick turnaround and congrats to all.

A few clarifications from our side:
- May 16 go-live is preferred but procurement may need up to 10 business days after DocuSign. We can prioritize technical pre-checks earlier.
- Carlos: we'll need the static outbound IP and the KMS integration details to coordinate with our security team.
- Can you share the perf-validation plan and an initial SLA/monitoring matrix so our Ops team knows what telemetry to expect?

We're excited to get started — happy to do a 30-minute alignment before the pre-checks to walk the diagram and responsibilities.

Best,
Leah

Leah, Carlos — welcome. Proposed immediate next steps (I will own coordination and the mutual action plan):

1) Pre-check call: Tue, May 4 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes (please confirm). Agenda: introductions, network diagram review, static IP and KMS handoff, perf-validation plan review.
2) Ben to share provisioning runbook + perf-validation steps by Apr 5 COB.
3) Marissa will confirm DocuSign status; procurement contact is copied.
4) Onboarding timeline: technical pre-checks May 9–11; canary traffic May 13–15; target go-live May 16 pending procurement and validation.

Deliverables I will produce this week:
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone owners
- Kickoff agenda and roles matrix
- Post-kickoff 30/60 day success milestones and health checks

Please confirm the May 4 pre-check slot or propose alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to working with the Emberly team.

Olga
